key_findings: CBD at micromolar concentrations broadly inhibited sensory neuron activation by ionotropic and metabotropic agonists including capsaicin, BK and PGE2.
Submicromolar CBD reduced nociceptor excitability, blocked Na and K currents slowly, and eliminated vincristine-induced capsaicin sensitization.
